{{Quote|I'm going to ask you once more. And unless you want my associate to do that again, you're going to answer me.|Major Acota to [[Jilo Del]]|<ref name="Krallet" />}}
'''Acota''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. After the mercenary, [[Jilo Del]], was turned in for the eradication of an entire colony, Acota was in charge of interrogating him, and forced him to reveal that Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hyshiri]] had ordered the attack. Afterward, Acota had Del indentured into the Army and promised him great compensation and free rein in order to found a unit of ruthless mercenaries in order to do the Empire's bidding. This unit would become known as [[Krallet Division]], and would be responsible for some of the worst atrocities committed during the War.<ref name="Krallet" />
